Introduction

T-Angel, short for Trot Angel, is a four-member trot-idol girl group. As of 2023, the group consists of Juhee, Sea, Shinbi, and Suhyeon.

They made their official debut on July 21, 2010 with the release of the single album "T-Story" and its title track "Oppaya".
